case.title: A view-only user can reorder technician columns and Unassigned stays first
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 2 browsers · about 25 minutes
  • Build: staging (https://app.staging.shopview.com), v26.40.17-a5c4210. Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • [User-A]: the dispatcher, Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit. [User-A] also does the setup.
  • [User-B]: a view-only user (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Viewer") whose role (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST WO View Only") has under Work orders only View ticked, at the test location; signed in later in a second browser or a private window. No technician is pinned for [User-B], and [User-B] has not reordered the technicians yet.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Viewer Column Order Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Viewer Column Order Golf Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Alpha Co", "Golf Co").
  • Work orders (both Approved): lead Ana — Alpha Co; no lead — Golf Co.
  • Starting technician order: Unassigned first, then technicians by first name (Ana, Ben, Cal) for both users.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Create a view-only user (skip if one exists): Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create Custom Role > Skip > Role Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST WO View Only") > under Work orders tick only View > Create. Then Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Viewer", an email inbox you can open) with that role at the test location, and finish the invite so the user can sign in. Record this user as [User-B].
  3. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Viewer Column Order Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Viewer Column Order Golf Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click the Finance tab and click Mark Reviewed; in the Mark as reviewed window fill Mileage or Engine Hours if asked and click Confirm review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co").
  5. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Viewer Column Order" in Search — exactly 2 work orders show, both Approved: Alpha Co led by Ana, Golf Co with no lead. In Board View as [User-A] the columns read Unassigned, Ana, Ben, Cal with nothing pinned; if a technician is pinned, unpin it (pin icon in the column header) and pin it back after the case. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.
case.custom_steps:
1. Sign in as the view-only user [User-B] (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST Viewer).
  2. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  3. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Viewer Column Order" in Search so only this case's work orders show.
  4. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  5. Write down the column order (initially Unassigned first, then technicians by first name: Ana, Ben, Cal).
  6. Press on the drag handle at the left of Cal's column header (the six-dot handle) and drag Cal's column before Ana's, then release.
  7. Try to drag Ben's column to the left of the Unassigned column and release there.
  8. Try to press on the Unassigned column header and drag it to the right of Cal.
  9. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").
  10. Try to drag Ben's group header above the Unassigned group and release there.
  11. Refresh the page (F5) and read the technician order in Tech View and in Board View.
  12. In another browser, sign in as the dispatcher [User-A] (create and edit user), open Work Orders > All > Board View and read the technician order.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the view-only user can drag a technician column. The order becomes Unassigned, Cal, Ana, Ben.
  • Step 7: Ben cannot be placed before Unassigned. Unassigned stays the first column.
  • Step 8: the Unassigned column cannot be dragged.
  • Step 10: in Tech View, Unassigned stays the first group and Ben cannot be dropped above it.
  • Step 11: after the refresh the view-only user still sees Unassigned, Cal, Ana, Ben in both views.
  • Step 12: the dispatcher's own technician order is unchanged (Unassigned, Ana, Ben, Cal) because the order is saved per user.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-R2, S9-R8, read 8 Oct 2026. Story 9 prerequisite and Key Decisions (Permissions), same PRD. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) Phase 9 drop rules.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R2: “Users with Work Orders view permission can reorder technician groups and columns. The order is saved per user.”
  • S9-R8: “Keep Unassigned fixed during technician reordering.”
  • Story 9 prerequisite: “View permission permits technician-only group/column reordering.”
  • Key decision: permissions: “Permissions. Work Orders view permits viewing all four filter tabs and reordering technician groups/columns.”
  • Tech plan Phase 9 drop rules: “technician-group drags stay inside their area — pinned technicians reorder only among pins, and Unassigned is never a technician drop target (S9-R8, S9-R9)”

Last checked against build v26.40.17-a5c4210 (staging) on 10/15/2026.

changes.label: Steps
changes.old_value:
1. Sign in as the view-only user (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST Viewer).
  2. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  3. Type "ZZAUTOTEST" in Search so only your test work orders show.

  11. Refresh the page (F5) and read the technician order in Tech View and in Board View.
  12. In another browser, sign in as the dispatcher (create and edit user), open Work Orders > All > Board View and read the technician order.

Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click the Finance tab and click Mark Reviewed; in the Mark as reviewed window fill Mileage or Engine Hours if asked and click Confirm review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co").
  5. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Viewer Column Order" in Search — exactly 2 work orders show, both Approved: Alpha Co led by Ana, Golf Co with no lead. In Board View as [User-A] the columns read Unassigned, Ana, Ben, Cal with nothing pinned; if a technician is pinned, unpin it (pin icon in the column header) and pin it back after the case. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.
